jobs.occupation: Electronics/Firmware Engineer for Medical Laser Company
jobs.description:
Reporting to the R&D manager, your tasks will be highly diversified and will include:

• Define, describe, and design electronics of new and existing products

• Identify and integrate electronic modules into systems

• Analyze malfunctions or handle part replacements or re-designs

• Verify designs and design integrations to raise product quality

• Be an active part of the R&D team on development projects and support existing products

• Write and review Software

• Prepare required documents due to regulatory and quality measurement required for medical devices

Candidate profile:

Your qualifications should include a technical background with a preference for system analysis or technical exposure, preferably including:

• An engineering degree or equivalent work experience required

• Experienced with electronics circuit and PCB layout design

• Experienced with firmware development in C/C++

• Handling the PCB and electronics supply chain (ordering, BOM’s, documentation)

• Experienced with Design for Electrical Safety and EMC testing

• Excellent technical oral and written skills in English

Furthermore, the ideal candidate would have experience with

• IEC 60601 and ISO 13485 standards

• Digital communication standards such as USB, CAN Bus, SPI, …

You will be part of a small, dedicated team. In return, you are offered flexible working hours and a strong influence on how your job is carried out.

Innovative and ambitious mobile health company seeks ambitious IT specialist to support our global growth.

MONSENSO is a passionate team dedicated to designing innovative personal health technology that helps people, care providers and societies overcome the burden of mental illness.

In continuation of the Monsenso’s growth and thus increased activities, we are looking for an IT Specialist to join our team. At Monsenso we value the partnership between IT and business, and we expect you as our new colleague to be both flexible and proactive, and even seeking new ways to optimize and improve our systems and processes.

In addition to collaboration with colleagues, suppliers and partners your work will consist of tasks with administration, maintenance, operation, support and capacity planning.

We offer an exciting work in an international company with pride in the products and respect for each other, and we emphasize high professionalism, deadlines and initiative. The tone is informal with focus on progress and results.

Key responsibilities

· As an IT Development & Operations Specialist, you will be responsible for planning and handling our efforts related to:

Ensuring that the production network is safe and secure

● Ensuring the IT systems and software in the Monsenso solution are functioning at peak efficiency

● Communicating planned changes or upgrades

● Escalating incidents to partners and IT colleagues

● Ensuring system efficiencies and uptime

Essential Skills and Expertise

As a person you are structured and solution-oriented. We expect that you are fluent in English, both written and spoken. You are able to understand the customer value of the solutions we offer, and you focus on how we can best contribute to future opportunities and innovation. You must have well-developed interpersonal skills and abilities to use and support your new colleagues.

You have an educational background in IT or similar professional certification and minimum 3 years experience, but the right graduates with proven skills may also be considered.

We expect the successful candidate to master the following:

● Networking and troubleshooting

● Continuous software integration systems such as Jenkins

● Managing document oriented databases

● Active Directory management

It is a further plus if you have experience with one or more of the following points:

● Support of development (e.g. Application rollouts)

● Agile methodologies and continuous integration

● Monitoring tools

● Documentation

What we offer

We offer a fantastic opportunity to join a young growth company, where you truly have the ability to make an impact and help shape the future in an exciting field. Personal health technology and mHealth are booming markets worldwide, and you will be at the center of this technology revolution. Mental health is as a major burden for society needing new solutions and ways of supporting treatment, and you will contribute to reducing this burden for the benefit of society and the people affected.

You should expect an informal, fast-paced environment with tremendous opportunities for personal development for the right people.

jobs.occupation: Senior Professional, Security Operations Center, Incident Manager
jobs.description:
The Impact You'll Make

As a Security professional and incident manager, as part of the security operations center team responsible for managing security incidents and problems to protect Danfoss. Coordinate security projects or activities with both internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective delivery.

What You’ll Be Doing

•    Collaborate with incident managers to facilitate stand-up meetings and security incidents, problem management, conduct thorough root cause analyses, capture lessons learned, and ensure effective communication.

•    Participate in security investigations by validating scope, impact, and severity, serving as an escalation point for the security incident response process.

•    Act as the facilitator for assigned security projects or activities, ensuring efficient planning, execution, and quality stakeholder communication in collaboration with both internal and external partners.

•    Lead service areas to drive the implementation and continuous improvement of services.

•    Engage with stakeholders to align and implement robust security controls aimed at preventing cybersecurity incidents.

•    Utilize threat feeds and perform security assessments of infrastructure and applications, report information security weaknesses, and assist with remediation.

•    Liaise with vendors and IT personnel to support the development and maturation of the Danfoss Security Operations Center.

What We're Looking For

• A bachelor’s degree in computer science, information sciences, or a related field from an accredited college or university is typically required for an IT Senior Security professional.

• Certification for Security professional is generally preferred. Recognized certifications include Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Auditor (CISA), GIAC, CISM, CCIE, CCNA, or other relevant security credentials.

• Knowledge:

•    A minimum of 3 years of experience in Information Technology is required, including expertise in IT infrastructure as well as applications development or support. Previous experience working in IT Security, Security Operations Center, or Computer Incident Response Team is essential.

•    Candidates should have strong understanding of AI productivity tools and be able to use them to boost work efficiency.

•    Experience with project management and scum master is highly preferred.

•    Candidates should possess comprehensive knowledge of the ITIL framework, ISO27002 information security standards, and incident response processes related to information security.

• Strong verbal and written English required for effective professional interaction within the IT team and achieving departmental goals.

• Activity planning and collaboration essential for successful results.

• Needed for security incident response and risk prevention.

• Ability to present information clearly in both individual and small group settings.

• Must be able to investigate incidents, document findings, analyze data, and draw valid conclusions.

• Should maintain up-to-date knowledge of IT security best practices, with curiosity and analytical problem-solving abilities.

What You'll Get from Us

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

Our Commitment to Transparency

Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our FAQ Page.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Brand

Danfoss engineers solutions that increase machine productivity, reduce emissions, lower energy consumption, and enable electrification.

Our solutions are used in areas such as refrigeration, air conditioning, heating, power conversion, motor control, industrial machinery, marine, and on- and off-highway equipment. We also provide solutions for data centers, renewable energy, energy storage, heat recovery, as well as contribute to district energy solutions for cities.

Our innovative engineering dates back to 1933. Danfoss is family-owned and employs over 39,000 people. We create long-term value for our customers in more than 100 countries with a global footprint of around 100 factories.

Company Description

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Regional Sales Manager will play an important role and be a key contributor to the success of the company.

• Be fluent in English and German, Swedish or Danish.

• Possess excellent communications skills – orally as well as in writing.

• Be used to dealing with customers and often drive full sales cycles virtually.

• Have a good understanding of global (mental) health dynamics and the challenges it faces.

• Have a proven record in planning, prioritizing and delivering against a given budget.

• Take ownership of complex tasks and be a strong self-motivator.

• Hold a relevant degree in economics, business administration or engineering.

• Hold a permit to live and work in Copenhagen, Denmark. For an exceptional candidate based in a Northern European capital, home office could be considered.

• As a person, you strive in a challenging environment, where you have a possibility to see and influence the entirety. You bring a positive mindset and winning attitude, and you see the opportunities in all the things that are not yet in place in a young, growth company compared to an established corporation.

Additional Information

What we offer

We offer a fantastic opportunity to join a young growth company, where you truly have the ability to make an impact and help shape the future in an exciting field. Personal health technology and mHealth are booming markets worldwide, and you will be at the center of this technology revolution. Mental health is as a major burden for society needing new solutions and ways of supporting treatment, and you will contribute to reducing this burden for the benefit of society and the people affected.

jobs.occupation: Project Manager for strategic projects (maternity cover)
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Project Manager motivated by making a tangible difference? Pharmacosmos is looking for a Project Manager to lead complex, strategic projects across our value chain and deliver lasting impact across the organisation. You bring strong project leadership and analytical skills and are adept at engaging stakeholders at all organisational levels. If this sounds like you, we would like to hear from you.

Your role

As Project Manager, you will join our small project management team and lead two to five strategic projects in parallel. The projects vary in scale, complexity and nature and support areas such as the CEO Office, Clinical R&D, Legal, Supply Chain, Finance and HR. They may, for example, include digitalisation initiatives and IT system implementations.

You may become involved from the initial assessment of needs and requirements through business-case development, solution evaluation, implementation and final reporting. Where external vendors are involved, you will lead the request-for-proposal process and support vendor evaluation and selection.

This is a hands-on role. In addition to managing and coordinating projects, you will actively contribute to project execution. You will establish the appropriate project organisation and governance, clarify roles and responsibilities, engage stakeholders and ensure effective reporting on progress, milestones and financials.

Your ability to combine project management expertise with strong business acumen will be key to your success. Through a professional and respectful approach, you will build trust and create the right conditions for the project team and stakeholders to succeed.

You will be part of the Data & Projects department and report directly to the Director of the department.

Your key responsibilities

• 
Lead strategic projects from initial assessment through implementation and close-out

• 
Develop and refine business cases, requirements and solution evaluations

• 
Lead vendor selection processes, including requests for proposals and comparison of responses

• 
Establish appropriate project governance, project teams and steering committees

• 
Manage project plans, progress, milestones, risks and financials

• 
Engage stakeholders and communicate project status to senior management and the wider      organisation

• 
Contribute actively to project execution and implementation

Your qualifications

We expect that you have:

• 
A relevant master’s degree in economics, business administration, engineering, science,      medicine or a related field

• 
At least three years of experience in strategy consulting, project management or a comparable      role

• 
Strong analytical skills and business acumen, with the ability to translate business needs      into practical solutions

• 
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, enabling you to engage stakeholders and drive      change

• 
Experience with project management tools and advanced skills in PowerPoint and Excel

• 
An open-minded, curious and pragmatic approach, combined with a strong sense of      accountability

• 
Fluency in written and spoken Danish and English

A recognised project management certification, such as PRINCE2, is an advantage.

Additional information

Your primary place of work will be Pharmacosmos’ headquarters in Holbæk. We offer flexible opportunities to work from home by agreement with your manager. Limited travel of approximately 5–10 days per year may be required.

This is a fixed-term maternity cover position starting in early/mid-November 2026 and lasting approximately 10–11 months.

Contact and application

Submit your resume and cover letter via the "Apply" button. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Director of Data & Projects Simon Guldberg at sgp@pharmacosmos.com.

You are welcome to submit your application in either Danish or English.

Pharmacosmos Pharmacosmos A/S is a global leader in carbohydrate chemistry and innovative treatments for iron deficiency and iron deficiency anaemia. Building on our foundational expertise in carbohydrate chemistry and cell cycle biology, we develop innovative treatments for unmet patient needs, with a focus on iron metabolism and blood-related disorders. Founded in 1965 and headquartered in Denmark, our team is made up of more than 650 specialists across the UK, Ireland, the Nordics, Germany, Canada, and the USA.

jobs.occupation: FP&A Analyst or Senior Analyst, Strategic Finance
jobs.description:
Do you know your way around a balance sheet and a liquidity forecast, and not just the P&L? We are looking for an FP&A Analyst or Senior Analyst to join our Strategic Finance team in Hobro.

Who we are

Eurowind Energy is a global and leading developer, owner and operator of energy parks. Based in Denmark, we operate in 16 countries around Europe and in the USA, and we are continuously growing our project portfolio. We believe in a future of renewable energy, and we have an ambitious plan of becoming the next generation's "Power Major". Based on a full value chain from greenfield project development to energy trading, more than 700 team members are dedicated to creating a greener future fueled with nothing but renewable energy!

We are looking for an experienced FP&A Analyst or Senior Analyst to join our Strategic Finance team in Hobro, Denmark. Based at our headquarters, you will be part of a team of three that provides financial planning, forecasting and analysis across the entire organisation. Strategic Finance is a small function within the CFO area, operating at group level in close collaboration with Group Finance and the business. We do not sit in project or asset controlling.

Your role

You will join a team of three in Strategic Finance. Modelling takes up the largest share of the week, closely followed by understanding how projects, assets and operations flow into the numbers. Collecting, reconciling and reviewing data, and turning it all into analysis, make up the rest.

This is a newly created position, as we are growing the team to match the scope ahead. There is no finished set of models to take over. You will help build them.

With Blackstone Infrastructure set to become a co-owner of Eurowind Energy, Strategic Finance expects to play a growing part in the financial planning and reporting that goes to our owners. Over time, you will work directly with reporting and analysis prepared for one of the world's largest infrastructure investors.

• Budgeting, forecasting and long term financial planning, with an emphasis on balance sheet modelling and liquidity forecasting

• Designing, building and developing integrated financial models (P&L, balance sheet and cash flow) at group, portfolio and project level

• Scenario and sensitivity analysis on liquidity, financing and portfolio development

• Monthly and quarterly management reporting and variance analysis

• Preparing presentations for the board and senior management

• Building and maintaining data pipelines and reconciliations between our ERP and our models

• Developing new reporting tools and dashboards, e.g. in Power BI, and shaping the processes behind them

You will also work with department heads and regional leads when the analysis calls for it, but business partnering is not the main focus. The core of the role is the modelling, the data and the analysis that sit behind the decisions.

What we offer

Strategic Finance sits close to the centre of the organisation, and the models built here are used for real decisions.

• Real influence on how our financial models and processes are built. Not just maintaining what exists, but shaping the structure, logic and methods behind them

• A say in how work is organised, from data flows to reporting cadence, in a team that is still taking shape

• Data from across the entire organisation, from development and construction to operations and offtake

• Room to improve how data flows into planning, reporting and analysis

• Close sparring, clear priorities and colleagues who are involved in the work

• Direct exposure to senior management and, over time, to owner level reporting

Required competencies and skills

We are looking for someone with 1 to 5 years of relevant experience. Whether you join as Analyst or Senior Analyst depends on your experience and how the match feels on both sides. The scope and the team are the same.

• A degree in finance, economics, business or a related field

• Experience in FP&A, controlling, consulting or a similar analytical role

• Solid understanding of balance sheet dynamics and liquidity forecasting

• Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills

• Experience working with data from ERP systems

• Experience with Power BI or similar reporting tools

• Curiosity about how the business works. You want to understand what drives the numbers, not just report them

• Structured and precise, comfortable with deadlines and shifting priorities

• Knowledge of the energy sector is an advantage

Please note that this role requires a clean criminal record.

Renewable energy is our future. And so are our people!

At Eurowind Energy we do our best to create a culture where everyone is valued and feels at home. You will notice this in your everyday work life, where you have the freedom to speak up and where your voice means something to us. We know that when you grow, we grow. Therefore, we strive to support you in what you believe is right and in your personal and professional development. We offer you an exciting job in an energetic and international environment. And we promise you: the wind is never standing still.

Developing, operating and managing wind and solar parks is not just pure business for us. It is a way to view the world. And with this worldview comes a genuine ambition to be one of the leading developers in Europe. Because creating a future run entirely on green energy matters to us.

We manage our own portfolio of projects and at the same time, we perform technical and financial management of projects. We have throughout many years experienced sustained economic growth in the number of developed projects and companies in management. And we continue to expect this. Simply because it is in our nature to keep developing – projects, companies and our people.

Did we capture your attention?

Great! If you see yourself in this role, do not hesitate to apply for the position. Please use the link below. As we continuously review incoming applications, please send us your CV and a brief cover letter as soon as possible. In the letter, tell us who you are and, in a few concrete examples, what you have actually delivered in your career so far, such as models you have built, processes you have improved or analyses that changed a decision.

Should you have any questions before applying, please feel free to contact Jeppe Falk Hansen, Lead Specialist, Strategic Finance & Insights, at jfh@ewe.dk.

We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis

Read more about Eurowind Energy on our website or LinkedIn

Application deadline:

As soon as possible

Vattenfall’s Operational Control Centre is a central part of our Business Unit Wind, Offshore, Generation. We monitor more than 1,500 wind turbines and provide support to all Vattenfall sites Onshore and Offshore within turbine monitoring, high-voltage control, and marine coordination – 24/7, all year round. Our goal is to ensure high availability and safe operations, enabling us to accelerate the transition to a fossil-free society together.

Your Tasks

As a Control Centre Operator, you will be a key person in the operation of our wind assets.

You will be responsible for:

• Monitoring and optimizing wind turbines and transformer stations in real time

• Responding quickly to alarms and unforeseen errors to minimize downtime

• Planning and performing switching operations under Wind Electrical Safety Rules (WESR)

• Handling permits and ensuring proper return to normal operation after maintenance or incidents

• Ensuring open communication with internal teams and external authorities – both in daily operations and during critical incidents

• Preparing precise operational reports and contributing to the coordination of grid balance

• Identifying and sharing opportunities for process improvements across the organization

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

• Has a technical education as an electrician, wind turbine technician, or similar

• Has experience with electrical systems or wind turbine operations – experience from a control room is an advantage

• Thrives with shift work and being able to keep your head cool under pressure

• Has good IT skills and can navigate digital systems confidently

• Speaks and writes fluent Danish and English

• Has a strong safety focus and works systematically and collaboratively

• Can make independent decisions and communicate clearly with colleagues and partners

Additional Information

• Workplace: Esbjerg, Denmark. You must live within daily transport distance.

• All high-voltage tasks must be performed in accordance with applicable legislation.

• Security clearance from the Danish Energy Agency is required for this position.

Our offer

We can offer you the opportunity to make a real world difference whilst shaping your own working environment and career. We provide a competitive salary and benefits package, a progressive, inclusive culture, and the chance to work with some of the best in the industry. You will play a vital role within interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues; our ‘Ask and Share’ concept is embedded in the way we work. We also offer attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development.

Process and timeline

Please submit your application in English or Danish via our website. We do not accept applications in other ways.

We review applications and conduct interviews continuously, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The job posting will be closed once we have found the ideal candidate.

For more information about the position, please contact Martin Jul Tromborg on +45 27875466.

For more information about the recruitment process, please contact Senior Recruiter Jette Ingeberg on +45 22 57 07 51

Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation.

Company Description

Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 21 000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission.

Business Area Wind is responsible for Vattenfall’s Onshore and Offshore Wind as well as other non-hydro Renewable activities like solar PV and batteries. Job Description

Would you like to shape Denmark’s pension solutions of tomorrow? As our new Consultant, you’ll use your actuarial expertise to turn complex models and business logic into tangible solutions, creating value for clients and society. Join a major IT project and turn theory into practice.

Responsibilities

As a Consultant within the life and pensions industry, you will become part of a specialised team contributing to the development of a new, unified IT system for pension solutions in Denmark.

You will work at the intersection of deep expertise in actuarial mathematics and technical implementation in a dynamic, and ambitious environment. Your expertise will be at the heart of our work, and you will see your analyses, business insights, and models create direct value for our clients and their businesses. Your work will involve developing and implementing complex calculation models and ensuring that solutions meet both business and regulatory requirements.

In addition, you will gain broad insight into different companies within the pensions industry and develop expertise in delivering large-scale IT projects. You will work closely with actuaries and pension experts at our clients and contribute to building actuarial and pension-specific capabilities at Netcompany.

Your responsibilities will typically include:

• 
Developing and implementing calculation models for life and pension products.

• 
Quality assurance and testing of pension products, as well as bridging the gap between actuarial expertise and technical implementation.

• 
Ensuring that solutions comply with applicable legislation and standards.

• 
Communicating complex analyses and results to colleagues, developers, testers, and clients.

• 
Contributing to the design and customisation of insurance and pension products within our solutions.

About you

• 
You are a recent graduate or have a few years of relevant professional experience within actuarial mathematics.

• 
You hold a Master’s degree in actuarial science (cand.act.) or a similar relevant degree that has given you a strong academic foundation and a logical approach to handling large datasets and advanced models.

• 
You thrive in a dynamic environment focused on collaboration and continuous personal and professional development.

• 
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritize an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

Send us an application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

WHO WE ARE

At Maersk, we are building enterprise-scale data and AI platforms to power intelligent, integrated supply chain solutions. Our ambition is to enable real-time visibility, AI-driven automation, and seamless data access across the business through a unified platform approach. We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to join us in this journey.

As a Senior Engineering Manager for AI & Data Platform, you will lead one or more engineering teams responsible for delivering scalable data platforms and AI-enabled capabilities. You will drive execution across data engineering, platform development, and agentic AI enablement, ensuring solutions are aligned to enterprise strategy and deliver measurable business outcomes. The role is accountable for delivery, engineering quality, team capability, and platform reliability rather than purely strategy definition.

Key Responsibilities:

1. AI & Data Platform Delivery

• Lead delivery of data platforms, data products, and AI-enabled applications supporting enterprise use cases

• Enable agentic AI adoption, ensuring data pipelines and platforms support AI-driven workflows and decisioning

jobs.description:
Tenure-track Assistant Professor, Associate Professor or Full Professor of Food Processing & Technology

Department of Food Science

Faculty of Science

University of Copenhagen

The Department of Food Science, Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor, Associate Professor or Full Professor in Food Processing and Technology. Applicants must be capable of, and interested in, conducting and developing basic and applied interdisciplinary research of high international standard in the field of food processing and technology. The position will involve extensive collaborations within the department and with national and international academic groups and industrial partners. Research within the Department has a mission to unearth new solutions for society and industry to support sustainable food production, food security and safety as well as production of high-quality food promoting human health and wellbeing. The Department of Food Science is recognized for excellence in food research, education, and industrial collaborations. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. We encourage applications from a range of disciplines within the food science and technology area, ideally covering the understanding of food macromolecular interactions on a mechanistic level, how processing and formulation affect or determine these interactions, and how this influences final product quality with focus on functional properties.

We are seeking a candidate who will establish an internationally leading research program, and we encourage a diverse range of applicants whose work may center on one or more of the following disciplines:

• Developing a mechanistic understanding of interactions of food macromolecules in complex matrices during processing or formulation spanning dairy, plant, and single-cell protein sources.

• How this knowledge can be used in the rational design of functional ingredients and healthy foods using established and emerging processing technologies

• Development and utilization of high throughput methods for characterizing and quantifying the physicochemical behavior of food macromolecules in complex matrices.

• Modelling and the use of machine learning/AI for simulation and prediction of the outcome of process unit operations on food and ingredient functionality.

• Formulation and fluid dynamics of complex emulsions and the mechanisms governing this.

In addition, it is expected that this position will be involved in a significant amount of collaboration with industry, and therefore it is expected that the successful candidate has a documented successful track record in industry collaboration and working with innovation-oriented research. Furthermore, we expect that the successful candidate has a genuine interest in leadership and the wellbeing and development of their group.

Tenure-track assistant professor

The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations with regards to publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within the Tenure Track Assistant Professorship. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties.

The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact.

Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered.

Associate professor and full professor

Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.

In particular, the candidate must actively contribute with research-based teaching on the BSc in Food Science and Nutrition, and the MSc in Food Science and Technology programs, with an emphasis on the specialization in Dairy Science and Technology.

Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department.

Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship and full professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered.

University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit

General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor / associate professor / professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.

Please read more here:

For tenure-track assistant professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5a_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Assistant_professors.pdf

For associate professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5b_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Associate_professors.pdf

For professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5c_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-professors.pdf

Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here

The tenure-track assistant programme

The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures.

Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields.

After a 6-year tenure-track period tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen.

Salary and employment conditions

The position is open from 1 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

Employment is either as tenure track assistant professor, associate professor or professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

This position comes with an opportunity to negotiate a start package that will help leverage the candidate’s scientific deliverables in the initial years of employment. The negotiation for the start package takes place as part of the recruitment process. Please read about the contents of the programme and conditions, as well as UCPH’s extensive support for international researchers, here Start package programme – University of Copenhagen .

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

The successful candidate will be a part of the Section for Ingredients and Dairy Technology. The section has internationally acknowledged expertise within novel sustainable processing technologies, protein, polyphenol and lipid chemistry, functionality, and modification of food components, kinetics, oxidation, food engineering, rheology, digitalisation, and advanced data analysis. The section is also equipped with pilot facilities for brewing, dairy and bioprocessing. The section has extensive collaborations on research projects with major food industries in both Denmark and abroad.

Further information on the Department is linked at Department of Food Science – University of Copenhagen Inquiries about the position can be made to Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department, Colin Ray (+45 93565911, colin.ray@food.ku.dk) or Head of Section, Mogens Larsen Andersen (+45 3533 3262, mola@food.ku.dk).

Filing of application

The position may be applied for at the tenure-track assistant professor level, associate professor level or full professor level. Please note that it is possible to apply at more than one level. If applied at more than one level, separate applications must be submitted (see below).

The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

Applying for the tenure-track assistant professorship please include

• 
Curriculum vitae including:

• Please describe and document international network and relations

• Please describe and document internationally based activities

• Positions held at universities/research institutions outside Denmark

• Outreach activities, i.e. popular lectures or other activities in the media

• Grants held, personal or in part. Career development grants.

• 
Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)

• 
Research plan - description of current and future research plans

• 
If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications- please describe and document:

• Experience with supervision of BSc and MSc students

• Teaching experience

• Formal pedagogical training

• 
Complete publication list

• 
Separate reprints of up to 5 particularly relevant papers

Applying for the associate professorship or full professorship please include

• Curriculum vitae including information about external funding

• Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)

• Research plan – description of current and future research plans

• Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines

• Complete publication list

• Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers

The deadline for applications is 27 October 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.

After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.

You can read about the recruitment process at https://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/

Interviews will be held on 25 February 2027.

211-0262/26-2N, Tenure-track Assistant Professor of Food Processing & Technology.

In this role, you will combine hands-on troubleshooting with strategic infrastructure improvements. From resolving complex network challenges to implementing new technologies, your work will directly contribute to a modern, secure, and high-performing IT environment.

We are building an AI-powered operating model for Ocean Operations and a next-generation optimisation capability for global Network Design. This role is not limited to agent orchestration or execution workflows. It is a senior technical leadership role for how AI strengthens optimisation methods, modelling, and decision quality across both planning and execution.

The remit is broader than a standalone AI feature set. It covers how AI, optimisation, and engineering come together to deliver better network decisions at scale, while also shaping agentic decision systems in Control Tower style execution environments.

Role purpose:

The Principal AI Engineer will set the technical direction for AI-augmented optimisation and intelligent operational decisioning. This person will lead through specialists in optimisation, modelling, heuristics, analytics, and experimentation. They will define where AI can materially improve search, structural recommendations, and solver-backed workflows, while also guiding the design of multi-agent systems for reasoning, orchestration, exception handling, and human-in-the-loop execution.

What you will own?

•Technical direction for AI-augmented optimisation and agentic decision systems across Network Design and operational execution

•How planning problems are framed and where AI can improve search, candidate generation, structural recommendations, and decision quality

•The interface between AI systems, heuristics, solver layers, optimisation services, and enterprise workflows

•Patterns for when AI should recommend, act autonomously, or escalate to humans

•The quality bar for experimentation, evaluation, and translation of new methods into measurable value for planners and decision-makers

•Reusable intelligence patterns that can scale across both Control Tower and Network Design use cases

Key responsibilities:

•Lead the optimisation intelligence agenda across network design, routing, vessel deployment, cargo flow, and operational decisioning

•Set direction for how teams define problem structures, formulate optimisation approaches, design heuristics, and identify where AI can improve search, modelling quality, and decision outcomes

•Guide specialists building optimisation models, analytical components, and AI capabilities, ensuring their work fits into a coherent AI plus OR architecture

•Drive structured experimentation to compare alternative methods, validate model behaviour, and improve performance, robustness, and scalability

•Define how AI systems should interact with solver layers, heuristics, and optimisation services rather than treating AI as a separate layer

•Lead the use of agentic AI where it adds value to reasoning, orchestration, exception handling, and human-in-the-loop decision support

•Shape the innovation roadmap by identifying promising new methods and accelerating them into pilots and scaled capabilities

•Raise standards across modelling practice, technical quality, experimentation discipline, and architectural judgment

•Communicate assumptions, trade-offs, and limitations clearly to senior stakeholders and decision-makers

What we are looking for?

We are looking for a senior technical leader with deep credibility across both AI and optimisation, and with the ability to lead through highly skilled specialists rather than doing all modelling work personally.

The strongest profile will combine experience in agentic AI systems and human-in-the-loop workflows with strong grounding in optimisation methods such as heuristics, search, mathematical programming, decomposition, or hybrid AI plus OR approaches. This person should also be comfortable directing teams working on modelling, experimentation, performance improvement, and implementation into production environments.

Required qualifications:

•Advanced degree in engineering, mathematics, computer science, operations research, or another quantitative field

•Significant experience leading applied AI, decision intelligence, optimisation, or analytical platform work in complex operational domains

•Strong understanding of optimisation and modelling principles and how algorithms support real planning problems

•Experience improving planning, routing, scheduling, or network optimisation through heuristics, analytics, or AI-based enhancements

•Strong Python skills and comfort working closely with software and data engineering teams

•Proven ability to lead experimentation, validate model performance, and convert technical ideas into business-relevant capabilities

•Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders

Preferred qualifications:

•Experience in logistics, supply chain, shipping, transportation, or another optimisation-heavy industry

•Exposure to large-scale network design, routing, fleet planning, cargo flow optimisation, or similar decision systems

•Experience using AI or ML to improve optimisation performance, such as learning-augmented algorithms, surrogate models, search guidance, or reinforcement learning

•Experience working across research, prototyping, and productionisation of optimisation methods

Leadership expectations:

This role is expected to lead through others. The Principal AI Engineer should create the technical direction, decision framework, and quality standards for a broader team of optimisation, analytics, and AI specialists. The role should not be framed as a lone architect writing models end to end. It should be framed as the senior leader who sets the optimisation intelligence agenda and ensures that specialist work compounds into a coherent capability.

jobs.description:
Opportunity:

At Maersk, we are transforming global logistics through innovation, operational excellence, and customer-centric solutions. Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) is a critical enabler of that transformation, helping us build trust, strengthen customer partnerships, and support sustainable business growth.

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Customer HSE & Strategic Partnerships to lead strategic HSE engagement with selected Global Key Customers across Logistics & Services (L&S). This role will position HSE as a strategic differentiator by translating Maersk's HSE capabilities, governance, compliance programs, and risk management expertise into tangible customer value.

Working at the intersection of HSE, commercial strategy, customer engagement, and governance, you will build trusted partnerships with senior customer stakeholders, support business growth opportunities, and establish the governance frameworks required to manage strategic customer HSE requirements across a global organization.

What We Offer

This is a unique opportunity to shape how Maersk engages with key customers on HSE, compliance, sustainability, and risk management topics.

You will work across a highly diverse global stakeholder landscape, collaborate closely with commercial, legal, operational, and leadership teams, and play a key role in strengthening long-term customer HSE partnerships while enabling business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Customer Engagement

• 
Lead strategic HSE partnerships with selected Global Key Customers.

• 
Support executive and senior-level customer engagements.

• 
Contribute to strategic commercial opportunities by articulating the value of Maersk's HSE and sustainability capabilities.

• 
Develop customer-facing HSE value propositions, thought leadership materials, and executive presentations.

Customer HSE Governance & Commercial Support

• 
Establish governance, escalation, and decision-making frameworks for managing strategic customer HSE requirements across Logistics & Services.

• 
Coordinate significant customer HSE commitments and ensure alignment across relevant functions.

• 
Develop and maintain customer-facing HSE materials, capability portfolios, and response frameworks.

• 
Drive consistency, quality, and accuracy in external HSE communications and customer engagements.

• 
Leverage data analytics and AI-enabled tools to identify emerging customer needs, trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.

Risk, Compliance & Contractual Support

• 
Continuously develop HSE compliance, and risk management requirements within customer contracts and supplier standards.

• 
Partner with Commercial and Legal teams to evaluate significant HSE commitments.

• 
Monitor evolving customer expectations, regulatory developments, and industry trends.

• 
Translate complex HSE, risk, and compliance requirements into practical business solutions and customer value propositions.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for a strategic and commercially minded leader who combines strong HSE expertise with exceptional stakeholder engagement and business partnering capabilities.

You thrive in complex global organizations, are comfortable engaging at executive level, and understand how governance, compliance, and risk management can create value for customers and the business.

Preferred Qualifications

• 
Relevant Master’s Degree with Occupational Health, Safety, Environment, Compliance or similar.

• 
Significant experience in HSE, Risk Management, Compliance, Sustainability, Operations, or a related discipline.

• 
Strong knowledge of management systems and international standards, including ISO 45001, ISO 14001, and ISO 9001.

• 
Solid experience with Power BI, business intelligence platforms, data mining and advanced reporting tools is an advantage.

• 
Experience utilizing digital, analytical, and AI-enabled tools to improve analysis, decision-making and customer engagement.

• 
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into business insights and recommendations.

• 
Demonstrated experience developing governance frameworks, policies, controls, and escalation processes in large, complex organizations.

• 
Strong commercial acumen and customer engagement experience.

• 
Experience working in global, matrixed environments.

• 
Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, and relationship-building skills.

• 
Strong executive communication, presentation, and storytelling capabilities.

• 
Ability to communicate complex technical requirements in a clear and commercially relevant manner.

Do you want to immerse yourself in testing and quality assurance of large and complex software projects that help digitalise and strengthen Denmark? Are you systematic, with a keen eye for detail? Then you might be the person we are looking for as our new Test Consultant.

Responsibilities and technologies

Testing and quality assurance are a crucial part of the IT solutions we develop together with our clients. As a Test Consultant, you will help test business-critical IT systems that have an impact not only on our public-sector and private-sector clients, but on people across Danish society.

You will always be part of a project team from Netcompany, typically working together on-site with the client. In this role, you will act as the link between the client, their business needs, and our technical solution.

You will continuously develop your testing and technical skills. Throughout your projects, you will gain hands-on experience with a wide range of the latest technologies and tools.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Ensuring the quality of the solution through various types of testing

• Analysing the functional aspects of the solution

• Preparing test plans and designing and writing test cases

• Executing functional and non-functional tests

• Contributing to troubleshooting and test reporting

About you

You can work methodically and connect business and IT-related challenges, explaining business needs to developers and technical aspects to clients. In addition, we imagine that you:

• Can navigate complex error scenarios and understand complex system landscapes

• Are systematic and detail-oriented throughout the analysis, design, development, and testing phases

• Think logically and analytically, and can break down and understand complex concepts and communicate issues and gaps clearly and effectively

• Thrive on a methodical and structured approach to your work

• Hold a relevant master’s degree

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

Maersk Air Cargo is accelerating the future of global logistics. As part of Maersk’s integrated end‑to‑end offering, our air cargo business connects speed, reliability, and scale—linking critical markets and enabling customers to move high‑value and time‑sensitive goods with confidence. With a growing global network and a clear ambition to redefine how air logistics supports supply chains, Maersk Air Cargo is where aviation meets transformation.

About the role

Maersk Air Cargo is seeking an Airworthiness Review Staff / Technical Records Engineer to cover the combined responsibilities of Airworthiness Review Staff (ARS) and Technical Records Engineer in a single integrated role.

The position plays a key role in ensuring continued airworthiness, regulatory compliance, and the integrity of aircraft records, in accordance with EASA Part‑CAMO and the company’s Continuing Airworthiness Management Exposition (CAME). The successful candidate will combine Airworthiness Review authority with ownership of technical records while actively contributing to aircraft transitions, fleet projects, and continuous improvement initiatives across the organisation.

This is a fully office-based role, requiring on-site presence five days per week at the advertised location.

Key Responsibilities

Airworthiness Review Staff (ARS) Responsibilities

• Perform Airworthiness Reviews (documentary and physical) in accordance with approved CAME procedures

• Issue, recommend, and manage Airworthiness Review Certificates (ARC), including extensions where applicable

• Ensure airworthiness reviews are conducted & verify continuing airworthiness compliance

• Coordinate findings, observations, and corrective actions with Engineering, Planning, and Compliance Monitoring

• Provide airworthiness expertise during audits, authority oversight, and internal compliance activities

Technical Records / Records Engineer Responsibilities

• Own the integrity and quality of continuing airworthiness records across the Maersk Air Cargo fleet, supporting operational excellence and regulatory compliance.

• Ensure correct structure and traceability of records

• Drive data quality and consistency across CAMO systems, digital records platforms, and archival solutions, contributing to the continued development of Maersk Air Cargo's airworthiness management environment.

• Participate in aircraft lease‑in and lease‑out projects, fleet transitions, and changes of aircraft registration as part of a dedicated cross‑functional team, ensuring successful records integration and regulatory compliance.

• Act as a key contributor during audits, regulatory oversight activities, and aircraft reviews, ensuring records are inspection-ready and support efficient compliance demonstration.

• Support the development and optimisation of technical records processes, digital tools, and airworthiness data management practices as the fleet and organisation continue to grow.

Qualifications and Experience

• Eligible for approval as Airworthiness Review Staff under EASA Part‑CAMO

• EASA Part 66 AML or relevant engineering degree

• A minimum of 5 years of experience in continuing airworthiness.

• Proven experience within continuing airworthiness management and technical records

• Strong knowledge of:

• EASA Part‑CAMO / Part‑M

• Airworthiness Review and ARC processes

• Maintenance Programs and AD management

• Experience with CAMO IT systems (e.g. Flydocs, CAMP, or equivalent)

• Highly structured, detail‑oriented, and audit‑experienced

• Able to work independently while collaborating effectively across Engineering, Planning, and Compliance functions

If you meet the EASA Part-CAMO requirements and are looking for a role that combines Airworthiness Review authority, technical records expertise, involvement in fleet transition projects, and the opportunity to influence how a growing cargo airline manages its continuing airworthiness activities, apply today and join Maersk Air Cargo!
